requirements.quote: Server actions (apps/web outward actions with cross-tenant ACTIONS registration)
share-menu (copy, wa.me and mailto links opened by the user in a new window, download)
all states (skeleton, empty, error, offline, denied)
`outward` i18n namespace en/ta/kn plus catalog test
Storybook stories with interaction tests, a11y.

requirements.why: Part 1 (#735) is merged; the missing read model is added in D1 so the UI can consume it.

deliverables.change: New read model: listDrafts(deps, actor, filter?) returning ready drafts (id, matterId, matter title, audience, language, tone, status, createdAt, latest body preview) and getDraft(deps, actor, draftId) returning latest version body, system (first) version body, facts with provenance, versions list. Same scope, draft.write and matter-visibility rules as saveEdit (diff.ts:99-122); not-found for another workspace's id. Exclude fully shared drafts from the ready list.
Export listDrafts, getDraft and their view types.
Tests for listDrafts/getDraft: lists, ordering, latest vs system version, clerk denied, restricted matter hidden.
Extend the outward cross-tenant describe (line ~3533): B on A's listDrafts sees nothing and getDraft is NOT_FOUND; A is unchanged.

'use server' actions via workspaceAction: composeDraftAction (draft.write; generation), saveDraftEditAction, markDraftSharedAction (channel enum, records via recordShared/recordCopied only; no transport), each strict zod from @causedeck/validators/outward-draft, assertCan draft.write, lazy core imports, revalidatePath of drafts and inbox. Read helpers for the page stay in lib, not 'use server'.
Import _outward/actions.ts, add every exported action to ACTIONS with probe inputs (uuid of another workspace's draft/matter).
Pure builders: whatsappHref(text), mailtoHref(subject, body), downloadBlob(text, filename); encode text; hrefs are wa.me / mailto: only; plus unit test apps/web/lib/outward/share-links.test.ts.

ReadyItemProvider id 'outward' registered with registerReadyProvider: list maps listDrafts to ReadyItem (title, summary with audience/language/matter, copy and wa.me/mailto open actions); markSent calls recordShared. Plus test apps/web/lib/outward/ready-provider.test.ts. Registration is imported for side effect from the inbox page (D9).
Import the outward ready provider module so it is registered before listReadyItems runs; no other behaviour change.

Client editor: labelled textarea (serif, 1.7 line height, lang attribute per draft, Indic fallback), banner, fact chips/right rail with provenance and 'to be confirmed' flags, guard warnings as amber text notes, save edit, Cmd/Ctrl+Enter copy, l cycles language, d toggles diff, Esc closes, aria-live announcements on copy and language change, 180 ms fade with reduced-motion fallback.

Copy (clipboard), Open in WhatsApp and Open in email (window.open(href,'_blank','noopener,noreferrer') on user click, then markShared action), Download; sticky bottom bar at 360 px; Mark shared; disabled with explanation offline/denied.
Segmented control EN / தமிழ் / ಕನ್ನಡ (toggle-group) with accessible names.
Renders DiffPart[] with +/- text markers as well as colour, sr-only labels.

Ready-to-send draft cards (audience chip, language chip, matter, 3-line preview, age) plus states component: skeleton, empty ('No updates waiting'), error with retry, offline (editing allowed, generation disabled), denied; split view at 768 px+.
Storybook stories for every component with default, empty, loading, error, offline, denied states and play-function interaction tests; a11y addon clean.
Component tests: banner text, keyboard shortcuts, share hrefs opened with noopener and no server transport, denied/offline states.
Replace placeholderPage with the server page: membership check, draft.write gate (PermissionDenied for clerk), listDrafts/getDraft via runtime.inWorkspace, render list and editor.
Skeleton state.
Error boundary with retry (copy the memory/error.tsx pattern).
Complete English strings incl. the banner 'Draft for you to review and send yourself. CauseDeck does not send messages.', states, shortcuts, share, language names, a11y announcements.
Same keys stubbed for Tamil, copying the stub convention of the other ta files.
Same keys stubbed for Kannada.
Register the 'outward' namespace.
Add 'outward' to the expected namespace list.

preserve.what: Outward core service signatures and behaviour (composeUpdate, saveEdit, recordShared, recordCopied, guardOutward) in packages/core/src/outward/*.ts, including the static no-send test packages/core/src/outward/__tests__/no-send.test.ts: no transport import, server never transmits draft text.

ReadyItemProvider/ReadyItem types and existing inbox behaviour in apps/web/lib/inbox/ready-providers.ts and apps/web/components/inbox/ready-to-send-list.tsx (providers that fail contribute nothing; empty when none).
Existing cross-tenant action probes and other i18n namespaces (apps/web/__tests__/cross-tenant-actions.test.ts, packages/i18n/src/messages/*).

validate.command: pnpm --filter @causedeck/core exec vitest run src/outward/__tests__/views.test.ts src/outward/__tests__/no-send.test.ts src/outward/__tests__/outward.test.ts --maxWorkers=${FORGE_HOST_PARALLELISM:-1}
pnpm --filter @causedeck/web exec vitest run __tests__/cross-tenant-actions.test.ts lib/outward components/outward components/inbox --maxWorkers=${FORGE_HOST_PARALLELISM:-1}

decisions.choice: Components and stories live in apps/web/components/outward/, actions in app/(app)/w/[slug]/_outward/actions.ts, not packages/ui/src/patterns/outward as the parent #69 suggests.
decisions.justification: apps/web/.storybook/main.ts:14 only globs ../components/**/*.stories; packages/ui/src/patterns/outward does not exist; web owns the next-intl strings and server actions; memory/inbox are precedents (apps/web/components/inbox/*).

decisions.choice: Add a core read model (listDrafts/getDraft) instead of querying tables from apps/web.
decisions.justification: Core has no draft reader (packages/core/src/outward/index.ts:3-15); core-domains rules keep table access in core and RLS-scoped via inOutwardScope (context.ts), so web must go through a core export.

decisions.choice: The drafts route at /w/[slug]/drafts hosts the split-view editor; the inbox Ready-to-send items link to it and offer copy/open hand-offs through the registered provider.
decisions.justification: drafts/page.tsx:1-3 is a placeholder already in shell nav; inbox ReadyAction supports only copy/open (ready-providers.ts:13-15).

decisions.choice: The only transport is a user-clicked wa.me/mailto: href opened with noopener in a new window; the server action only records the share.
